gen-gf-noto-serif-thai-general-sans: Noto Serif Thai sets an editorial, bookish tone, its lowercase crowding up toward the cap line with gentle thick-thin modulation. And General Sans follows in a smooth, pressure-steady line, a sans that carries a long passage without a snag.
gen-gf-noto-serif-thai-manrope: Manrope reads bright and approachable, every curve left with a generous opening and every stroke holding one width. Noto Serif Thai sits above it with sturdy hairlines, so the page moves from bookish to plain sans without a jolt.
gen-gf-noto-serif-thai-montserrat: Geometric and wide-eyed, with room to spare. Noto Serif Thai brings bookish, moderately shaded letters up top, while Montserrat glides along below like wire, so a long passage feels smooth under the eye.
gen-gf-noto-serif-thai-satoshi: Approachable is the first word for Satoshi's body text, but Noto Serif Thai leads with an editorial, bookish hand. Satoshi has a soaring x-height and arches matching its stems, so a large body setting would grow blunt beside that gently graded heading.
gen-gf-noto-serif-thai-switzer: Swiss and approachable below, bookish and editorial above: Switzer runs a marker-like constant line under Noto Serif Thai's stems, which are only a shade heavier than their arms. The difference in drawing is the draw.
gen-gf-noto-serif-thai-work-sans: Contemporary and modern, Work Sans keeps its mean line high and its joins as thick as its strokes. But Noto Serif Thai, bookish and editorial, adds diagonals gently pressed thinner than its verticals, giving the page a human edge.
gen-gf-noto-serif-tibetan-archivo: Archivo has a commanding x-height and curves that open outward, while Noto Serif Tibetan above it shows a faint nib pressure in its rounds. Literary meets editorial, with real chemistry.
gen-gf-noto-serif-tibetan-fs-asap: Refined and literary, Noto Serif Tibetan has stubby ascenders and bowls that thin slightly at the sides, which is its strength. Asap does the readable work, with open arcs and a body height nearly matching the capitals.
gen-gf-noto-serif-tibetan-fs-epilogue: Epilogue brings curvy, unclamped letters with a wire-like monoline skeleton and stubby ascender tips, set beneath Noto Serif Tibetan's faint pull between heavy verticals and lighter horizontals. Literary and contemporary, nicely mismatched.
gen-gf-noto-serif-tibetan-fs-fira-sans: Stubby ascenders and descenders beside a big x-height give Noto Serif Tibetan its look, with curves that lighten mildly toward their ends. Fira Sans follows in unshaded strokes with a large x-height, and a long passage stays clear.
